dialogues.jp: さて、今日の飯はどうするか……。
dialogues.en: What to do for today's lunch...
dialogues.text: What to do for today's lunch...

dialogues.jp: 購買に行って何か購入するか、それとも……。
dialogues.en: It's not only a case of where to go, or what to buy, but...
dialogues.text: It's not only a case of where to go, or what to buy, but...

dialogues.jp: と、死活問題について悩んでいると……。
dialogues.en: Also the threat of getting caught in a stampede...
dialogues.text: Also the threat of getting caught in a stampede...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san?"
dialogues.text: "Nii-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢か。どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もうお昼決まった？」
dialogues.en: "Have you already made plans for lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Have you already made plans for lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……うーん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その調子じゃ、まだ悩んでるみたいね」
dialogues.en: "I guess you're still thinking about it?"
dialogues.text: "I guess you're still thinking about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「一緒に食堂でも行きます？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to eat at the cafeteria together?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to eat at the cafeteria together?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うーん。食堂ねえ」
dialogues.en: "Hm. The cafeteria, eh."
dialogues.text: "Hm. The cafeteria, eh."

dialogues.jp: 別に、悪くはないが……。
dialogues.en: Well, that doesn't sound bad...
dialogues.text: Well, that doesn't sound bad...

dialogues.jp: いまいち方向性が定まらない。
dialogues.en: It doesn't really matter to me anyway.
dialogues.text: It doesn't really matter to me anyway.

dialogues.jp:
こういう日は、たいてい悩みぬいた挙句に、食
べ損ねるのが落ちだよな。
dialogues.en:
In the end, as long as my stomach's filled, I don't care how
it's done.
dialogues.text:
In the end, as long as my stomach's filled, I don't care how
it's done.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, nii-san!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, nii-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あのね私、今度、お｛はら／祓｝いに行こうかと思っ
　てるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I think, sometime soon, I'm going to go for one of those
exorcism rituals."
dialogues.text:
"I think, sometime soon, I'm going to go for one of those
exorcism rituals."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お祓い？」
dialogues.en: "Exorcism?"
dialogues.text: "Exorcism?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢のヤツ、何でまた急にそんなこと言い出す
んだ？
dialogues.en: That Nemu, what conclusion has she jumped to this time?
dialogues.text: That Nemu, what conclusion has she jumped to this time?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。たまに、変な熱とか出るでしょ。だか
　ら、見てもらおうかなって」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. You see, I've been feeling like my body's heating up,
lately..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. You see, I've been feeling like my body's heating up,
lately..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……なんでお祓いなんだよ。ちゃんと医者に
　｛み／診｝てもらえばいいだろ」
dialogues.en:
"...That sounds like it needs a doctor more than a
purification."
dialogues.text:
"...That sounds like it needs a doctor more than a
purification."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ま、まあそうなんだけどね」
dialogues.en: "Well, you could say that, kinda."
dialogues.text: "Well, you could say that, kinda."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は言葉を濁す。
dialogues.en: Nemu's words started trailing off.
dialogues.text: Nemu's words started trailing off.

dialogues.jp: 何かほかに、言いたいことでもあるのか？
dialogues.en: Now what is she trying to say?
dialogues.text: Now what is she trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「む、昔さ、よく縁日行ったよね」
dialogues.en: "We used to go to the shrine festivals before..."
dialogues.text: "We used to go to the shrine festivals before..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Haah?"
dialogues.text: "Haah?"

dialogues.jp: いきなり話が飛んだので訳がわからない。
dialogues.en: The topic took an unexpected turn.
dialogues.text: The topic took an unexpected turn.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は一体、何を考えてるんだ？
dialogues.en: What on earth is she thinking?
dialogues.text: What on earth is she thinking?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「焼きそばとか、りんご飴とか、おいしかった
　よね」
dialogues.en: "The candy apples and yakisoba were so good too..."
dialogues.text: "The candy apples and yakisoba were so good too..."

dialogues.jp: 焼きそば……。
dialogues.en: ...Yakisoba...?
dialogues.text: ...Yakisoba...?

dialogues.jp: なんか、急に腹減ってきたな。
dialogues.en: ...Now she's getting me hungry.
dialogues.text: ...Now she's getting me hungry.

dialogues.jp:
焼きそばから連想するため、必然的に焼きそば
パンに変身する。
dialogues.en:
Her mention of yakisoba immeidately transformed in my mind
to the thought of yakisoba bread.
dialogues.text:
Her mention of yakisoba immeidately transformed in my mind
to the thought of yakisoba bread.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、さっさと即決して、購買に走ればよ
かったとちょっと後悔する。
dialogues.en:
I better hurry up and decide for us, before everything's
gone.
dialogues.text:
I better hurry up and decide for us, before everything's
gone.

dialogues.jp: 「で、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "So, what's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Ah?"
dialogues.text: "Ah?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何か、言いたいことがあるんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "What were you talking about just now?"
dialogues.text: "What were you talking about just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Oh, uh..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, uh..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「遠慮すんなよ。別に、人様に言えないような
　悪いことをした訳じゃないんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"No need to be so restrained, I'm no blabbermouth. It's
nothing bad, right?"
dialogues.text:
"No need to be so restrained, I'm no blabbermouth. It's
nothing bad, right?"

dialogues.jp: 今日の音夢は珍しく遠まわしだ。
dialogues.en: Nemu was surprisingly distant today.
dialogues.text: Nemu was surprisingly distant today.

dialogues.jp:
よっぽど聞きづらい事なのか、回り道ばかりし
てくる。
dialogues.en:
Everytime I tried to bring that up, she tried to derail the
conversation.
dialogues.text:
Everytime I tried to bring that up, she tried to derail the
conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん……あのね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... well..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... well..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は俯いて話始める。
dialogues.en: Looking downwards, she began to speak.
dialogues.text: Looking downwards, she began to speak.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、気づいてはいたが、やはり環のこ
とだった。
dialogues.en: As I had somewhat expected, it was regarding Tamaki.
dialogues.text: As I had somewhat expected, it was regarding Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝までになる関係だったら、どこで会った
　んだろうって」
dialogues.en:
"When did that issue of her being your fiancee ever
happen...?"
dialogues.text:
"When did that issue of her being your fiancee ever
happen...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「縁日のときも、胡ノ宮さんっていなかったよ
　ね」
dialogues.en:
"Whenever we went to the shrine for the festivals, we never
met anyone like Tamaki..."
dialogues.text:
"Whenever we went to the shrine for the festivals, we never
met anyone like Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「子どもの頃……か？」
dialogues.en: "You mean, when we were kids...?"
dialogues.text: "You mean, when we were kids...?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の問いかけに、音夢は頷く。
dialogues.en: Nemu nodded at my question.
dialogues.text: Nemu nodded at my question.

dialogues.jp:
「確かに……、あの神社に環みたいな女の子は
　いなかった気がする」
dialogues.en:
"That is true... I don't remember seeing a girl like Tamaki
at the shrine, ever."
dialogues.text:
"That is true... I don't remember seeing a girl like Tamaki
at the shrine, ever."

dialogues.jp: 小さいときのことはあまり覚えてないけど。
dialogues.en: I can't remember that much about my childhood, admittedly.
dialogues.text: I can't remember that much about my childhood, admittedly.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、旅行以外で、この島を出たことはほとん
どない。
dialogues.en:
And besides the occasional trip, I've never left the island
either.
dialogues.text:
And besides the occasional trip, I've never left the island
either.

dialogues.jp:
出たにしても、何かの行事だ。知らない女の子
と仲良くなったなら、覚えているはずだ。
dialogues.en:
I don't have any particular memories of getting close to a
girl I didn't know, in my childhood days, either.
dialogues.text:
I don't have any particular memories of getting close to a
girl I didn't know, in my childhood days, either.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だったら……どうして知り合ったのかなって」
dialogues.en: "If that's the case... how did you come to know her?"
dialogues.text: "If that's the case... how did you come to know her?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢は上目遣いで俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Nemu lifted her gaze to me, as she enquired.
dialogues.text: Nemu lifted her gaze to me, as she enquired.

dialogues.jp: 縁日も遊びに行ってたけど、環の記憶はない。
dialogues.en:
I remember going to the shrine, but nothing at all about
Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
I remember going to the shrine, but nothing at all about
Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
「もともとこの島にいた訳でもなさそうだしな
　あ……」
dialogues.en:
"This might be easier to figure out if she had been on this
island the whole time..."
dialogues.text:
"This might be easier to figure out if she had been on this
island the whole time..."

dialogues.jp: 環は｛・・・／転校生｝だ。
dialogues.en: She is a transfer student, after all.
dialogues.text: She is a transfer student, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私……ずっと兄さんと一緒にいたのに、どう
　して覚えてないんだろうって」
dialogues.en:
"I've... always been by your side too, and I don't remember
anything about her."
dialogues.text:
"I've... always been by your side too, and I don't remember
anything about her."

dialogues.jp: まあ、確かにな……。
dialogues.en: Quite true...
dialogues.text: Quite true...

dialogues.jp:
もし、たまたまででも、あの神社に環がいたの
なら、音夢と俺のどちらかが覚えていても不思
議ではないのだが。
dialogues.en:
It would be very odd if she had lived in the shrine all the
while, with neither Nemu nor I noticing it.
dialogues.text:
It would be very odd if she had lived in the shrine all the
while, with neither Nemu nor I noticing it.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、多分、心配しなくても追い追いわかるっ
　て」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's nothing to worry about, I bet. We'd find out
sooner or later."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's nothing to worry about, I bet. We'd find out
sooner or later."

dialogues.jp: 結局、今はそんな結論しか出せなかった。
dialogues.en: That was the only conclusion I could come up to.
dialogues.text: That was the only conclusion I could come up to.

dialogues.jp:
本人にもわからないようなこと、｛ただ／質｝しようがな
い。
dialogues.en:
If the person herself doesn't know either, there's not much
we can do.
dialogues.text:
If the person herself doesn't know either, there's not much
we can do.

dialogues.jp:
それに許嫁っていっても、今日明日にでも、強
制的にケッコンさせられる訳ではなさそうだか
ら、あまり気にする必要もなさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
And despite calling me her fiancee, she hasn't tried to
force me into a marriage or anything... it's not worth
worrying about yet.
dialogues.text:
And despite calling me her fiancee, she hasn't tried to
force me into a marriage or anything... it's not worth
worrying about yet.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は黙って俯いてしまう。
dialogues.en: Nemu then bowed her head again, becoming silent.
dialogues.text: Nemu then bowed her head again, becoming silent.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What now?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「昔、兄さんが射的で人形取ってくれたなって」
dialogues.en:
"Years ago, you used to practice shooting at dummies, using
them as target practice..."
dialogues.text:
"Years ago, you used to practice shooting at dummies, using
them as target practice..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「人形？」
dialogues.en: "Dummies?"
dialogues.text: "Dummies?"

dialogues.jp: そんな古い話、それこそ覚えてない。
dialogues.en: Talking about such old stuff, how could I remember?
dialogues.text: Talking about such old stuff, how could I remember?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、結構上手で、内心、すごいなって思っ
　てたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You were really skilled at it, I thought."
dialogues.text: "You were really skilled at it, I thought."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今は、多分腕も落ちてるだろうな……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I haven't done it for years, so my proficiency's
probably dropped off..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I haven't done it for years, so my proficiency's
probably dropped off..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「こう構えて」
dialogues.en: "You'd stand like this..."
dialogues.text: "You'd stand like this..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は射的のポーズをする。
dialogues.en: Nemu imitated the post of someone getting read to shoot.
dialogues.text: Nemu imitated the post of someone getting read to shoot.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「バンって」
dialogues.en: "Then, bang--"
dialogues.text: "Then, bang--"

dialogues.jp: その声と共に、
dialogues.en: At the same time as her words,
dialogues.text: At the same time as her words,

dialogues.jp: ──ヒュン！
dialogues.en: --*hyuuu!*
dialogues.text: --*hyuuu!*

dialogues.jp: 俺達の間を、一筋に何かが｛かす／掠｝めていった。
dialogues.en: Something flew right past, in the space between us.
dialogues.text: Something flew right past, in the space between us.

dialogues.jp: ──ブスッ！
dialogues.en: --*tock!*
dialogues.text: --*tock!*

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.en: "A, ahh!"
dialogues.text: "A, ahh!"

dialogues.jp: 鈍い音と共に、悲鳴が聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
A dull sound, and a shrill shriek, rang out at the same
time.
dialogues.text:
A dull sound, and a shrill shriek, rang out at the same
time.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、男子学生が座ろうとしていた椅子に、
破魔矢が突き刺さっている。
dialogues.en:
An arrow, one of those used in shrine ceremonies to drive
off evil, was impaled into a chair about to be sat on.
dialogues.text:
An arrow, one of those used in shrine ceremonies to drive
off evil, was impaled into a chair about to be sat on.

dialogues.jp: 俺と音夢は、思わず顔を見合わせる。
dialogues.en: Nemu and I immediately turned to each other.
dialogues.text: Nemu and I immediately turned to each other.

dialogues.jp:
こんなことができるのは、学園広しと言えども
そうはいない。
dialogues.en:
There's only one person in school amazing enough to be able
to do this.
dialogues.text:
There's only one person in school amazing enough to be able
to do this.

dialogues.jp: ……環だな。
dialogues.en: ...Tamaki.
dialogues.text: ...Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: しかし、環の姿は見えない。
dialogues.en: But she was nowhere to be found.
dialogues.text: But she was nowhere to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん。これって……」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, this is..."
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, this is..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢が言おうとしたことを制し、矢が刺さっ
ている椅子を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Not really hearing her, I turned back to the arrowed chair.
dialogues.text: Not really hearing her, I turned back to the arrowed chair.

dialogues.jp: どうやら、男子生徒に怪我はないらしい。
dialogues.en: At least the guy doesn't seem to be injured...
dialogues.text: At least the guy doesn't seem to be injured...

dialogues.jp: 本当に、絶妙なタイミングで外すよな。
dialogues.en: That was some amazing timing.
dialogues.text: That was some amazing timing.

dialogues.jp: それとも、わざと外してんのか？
dialogues.en: Or maybe, it missed on purpose?
dialogues.text: Or maybe, it missed on purpose?

dialogues.jp: 俺は椅子に歩み寄る。
dialogues.en: I walked up to the chair.
dialogues.text: I walked up to the chair.

dialogues.jp: 一見、普通の椅子だけど……。
dialogues.en: At first glance, it looks like any other chair, yet...
dialogues.text: At first glance, it looks like any other chair, yet...

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、男子生徒を狙って矢を放ったのかな。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't look like a arrow aimed at the student on
purpose...
dialogues.text:
It doesn't look like a arrow aimed at the student on
purpose...

dialogues.jp:
背もたれには、白い羽が着いた矢が、まっすぐ
と突き刺さっている。
dialogues.en:
The directions of the feathers of the arrow showed that it
was shot straight, and at a low height.
dialogues.text:
The directions of the feathers of the arrow showed that it
was shot straight, and at a low height.

dialogues.jp: 俺は何気なく椅子に腰を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I cautiously tried sitting on the chair.
dialogues.text: I cautiously tried sitting on the chair.

dialogues.jp: ガタッ！
dialogues.en: *crash*
dialogues.text: *crash*

dialogues.jp: 「うわっ」
dialogues.en: "Uwah!"
dialogues.text: "Uwah!"

dialogues.jp:
椅子の足が折れ、椅子が倒れて俺はしりもちを
ついた。
dialogues.en:
The legs of the chair gave way, making the chair collapse,
and I fell flat on my backside.
dialogues.text:
The legs of the chair gave way, making the chair collapse,
and I fell flat on my backside.

dialogues.jp: 慌てて音夢が駆け寄ってくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu quickly rushed over to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu quickly rushed over to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, are you alright?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の目には、分かりやすいくらい、困惑の色
が映っている。
dialogues.en: The bewilderment in her eyes was clear to see.
dialogues.text: The bewilderment in her eyes was clear to see.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、なんとかな……」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah, more or less..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah, more or less..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は制服のホコリを払い、立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: I wiped the dust off my uniform, and stood up.
dialogues.text: I wiped the dust off my uniform, and stood up.

dialogues.jp: 何なんだ、これ……。
dialogues.en: The hell is this...?
dialogues.text: The hell is this...?

dialogues.jp: まるで、矢が警告みたいに見えなくもない。
dialogues.en: Maybe the arrow was a warning or something...
dialogues.text: Maybe the arrow was a warning or something...

dialogues.jp:
ただ、そばに環がいないので、何故矢を射たの
かも確認しようがない。
dialogues.en:
But since Tamaki isn't around, there's no way to find out
what's going on.
dialogues.text:
But since Tamaki isn't around, there's no way to find out
what's going on.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「危ないわね。矢もそうだけど、椅子も怖いわ
　ね」
dialogues.en:
"The chair must have been scared by the dangerous little
arrow."
dialogues.text:
"The chair must have been scared by the dangerous little
arrow."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は椅子を教室の片隅に持っていく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu brought the remains of the chair to a corner of the
classroom.
dialogues.text:
Nemu brought the remains of the chair to a corner of the
classroom.

dialogues.jp: さすが、風紀委員。
dialogues.en: Not bad, disciplinary committee.
dialogues.text: Not bad, disciplinary committee.

dialogues.jp: こういう時は頼りになる。
dialogues.en: You can always rely on them for times like these.
dialogues.text: You can always rely on them for times like these.

dialogues.jp: だけど……。
dialogues.en: Yet...
dialogues.text: Yet...

dialogues.jp: 俺はもう一度、片付けられた椅子の残骸を見る。
dialogues.en: I took another long look at the wrecked chair.
dialogues.text: I took another long look at the wrecked chair.

dialogues.jp: ……まあ、偶然かな。
dialogues.en: ...Nah, it has to be a coincidence.
dialogues.text: ...Nah, it has to be a coincidence.

dialogues.jp: ◆壊れた椅子◆
dialogues.en: ◆Destroyed Chair?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Destroyed Chair?◆

dialogues.jp:
休み時間、音夢は俺に、神社の話ばかり振って
くる。
dialogues.en: During the break, Nemu talked to me a lot about the shrine.
dialogues.text: During the break, Nemu talked to me a lot about the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
聞いてみると、何故環と｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝になったのか知り
たがっていた。
dialogues.en:
The long and the short of it, was that she wanted to know
how the notion that Tamaki was my fiancee came about.
dialogues.text:
The long and the short of it, was that she wanted to know
how the notion that Tamaki was my fiancee came about.

dialogues.jp: が、俺にもまだわからない。
dialogues.en: But even that, I didn't know.
dialogues.text: But even that, I didn't know.

dialogues.jp:
二人で縁日の射的の話をしていると、近くで弓
が射られた音がする。
dialogues.en:
As we talked about shooting arrows at the shrine festivals,
we heard the sound of a nearby arrow being shot.
dialogues.text:
As we talked about shooting arrows at the shrine festivals,
we heard the sound of a nearby arrow being shot.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、男子学生が座ろうとした椅子の背もた
れに破魔矢が刺さっている。
dialogues.en:
Looking around, we found a ceremonial arrow stuck into a
chair a male student was about to sit on.
dialogues.text:
Looking around, we found a ceremonial arrow stuck into a
chair a male student was about to sit on.

dialogues.jp:
俺がその椅子に座ろうとしたら、椅子の足が折
れて壊れてしまった。
dialogues.en: I tried sitting on the chair, and it instantly collapsed.
dialogues.text: I tried sitting on the chair, and it instantly collapsed.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、破魔矢が警告であったかのような気が
するのだった。
dialogues.en: Maybe the arrow was meant as a warning...
dialogues.text: Maybe the arrow was meant as a warning...
